'''Pak'pah''' was a juicy, purple [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that could only be grown on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]; [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] believed this was because of the [[wintrium]] found in Klatooine's soil. The pak'pah's skin had to be peeled before the fruit could be eaten. In [[44 ABY]], [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] bought some pak'pah from [[Kelkad]] and his father, [[Barada (Kelkad's father)|Barada]], in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Treema]] on Klatooine.
